RegistrationInfo.Description: W365 thin client (SCRIPT-FREE, FALLBACK): same as W365-LogoffOnStandbyWake but WITHOUT the DurationInUs floor - use only if the pilot build's Task Scheduler rejects the numeric comparison in the trigger query. Fires on every Lid / Power Button standby exit, including short lid flaps. Reason codes 15 (Lid) / 1 (Power Button) must be verified on the pilot build (see VERIFY.md).

EventTrigger.Subscription: <QueryList><Query Id="0" Path="System"><Select Path="System">*[System[Provider[@Name='Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power'] and (EventID=507)] and EventData[(Data[@Name='Reason']=15 or Data[@Name='Reason']=1)]]</Select></Query></QueryList>
